lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's one over four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 1/4? Nope!

lines.text: Snap a stick at two random spots: three pieces.
lines.caption: Snap a stick at 2 random spots: 3 pieces.

lines.text: What's the chance the longest piece is less than twice the shortest?
lines.caption: What's the chance the longest piece is less than twice the shortest?

lines.text: Make the stick sixty long. Two cuts make one dot in the square.
lines.caption: Make the stick 60 long. 2 cuts make 1 dot in the square.

lines.text: Keep the top half, a mirror of the bottom. Its area is one thousand eight hundred.
lines.caption: Keep the top half, a mirror of the bottom. Its area is 1800.

lines.text: Now light up every winning dot.
lines.caption: Now light up every winning dot.

lines.text: They make a hexagon: six triangles of thirty, so one hundred eighty!
lines.caption: They make a hexagon: 6 triangles of 30, so 180!

lines.text: One hundred eighty out of one thousand eight hundred. One over ten!
lines.caption: 180 out of 1800. 1/10!

lines.text: One over four, the triangle chance, was the trap.
lines.caption: 1/4, the triangle chance, was the trap.

lines.text: Did you get one over ten? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 1/10? Tell me below!
